title: Hunar: Ashara 1448 Waaz Visualisation
description: An interactive visualisation of Hunar (Skills), the topic of Ashara Mubārakah 1448H in London. The Majalis of the Waaz are arranged on a single wheel, one for each field: Clothing & Food, Info Tech, Architecture, Law & Medicine, Education, Business and Governance. Tap a number to step into that Majlis and explore its themes.
